Permits & License Committee  January 23, 2025
Minutes  Page 1 of 4

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  January 23, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
meeting ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on January 23, 2025 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera , Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Sgt.Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Service & Public Safety

  Staff Present:  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on January 09, 2025.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Ana Arias - Lopez on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a Free Document Shredding and
  E-Waste Donation Event on Saturday, March 22, 2025; Saturday; June 14, 2025; and
  Saturday, September 6, 2025, Public Property, from 9:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. Approval for
  three (3) time event on Grevillea Ave. Subject to Public Works approval for use/closure of
  the right-of-way. Applicant responsible for crowd control and event cleanup. Subject to all
  applicable IMC regulations.; Approved: Applicant to hire three (3) TCO's for intermittent
  traffic control-safety and two (2) City Hall security officers for public safety and safety of
  employees working this event. IPD watch commander will be notified and extra patrol
  provided as time permits. Adhere to all local, state and federal laws. Maintain site at all
  times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and
  staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County,
  and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00404863)

New Business License Request (s):

Item #2:  Marsha Tekeste DBA Lavender Blue Restaurant to operate as a parking lot at 529 E
  Manchester Blvd. APPROVED CONDITIONALL SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed
  license for more than six month will negatively impact your license renewal;Remittances of
  Parking Tax by the 20th of each month following collection; Approval for Special Event
  Parking Forum events only;Special Event Parking must not start before 6 pm Monday
  through Friday;On Site business must be closed 1 hour before Event Parking starts.Parking
  attendant or security guards must be on site during event parking at all times Ensure safe
  pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site and;No Tailgating;Adhere to all State, Federal
  and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to
  comply with any of the aforementioned will result in revocation of your business license and
  any future license application requests; Approval for parking for major events patrons. Must
  comply with all requirements of Section 12-42(G). Applicant must return to P&L for adjusted
  hours of parking for major events patrons before commencement of operations of the
  restaurant. No unlicensed Pedicab on the lot for pickup; Pedicab must be licensed with
  the City of Inglewod; Motion carried unanimously decision to cancel their event (Activity
  No. 00404754)
